_about: Hard-coded voice script for the ADX end-user prototype. The shopper says something; the first turn whose match words appear in what they said wins; the assistant replies with 'say'. Edit freely. {{today}} is filled from the browser date.

persona.context: Foundation page. Color IQ 526N (neutral). March order 516W (warm). Shade 526N selected, hovering over Add to Basket.

opening.say: Your March bottle was 516W and your Color IQ reads 526N. Can you share what changed since March?

turns.say: That makes sense. I've kept 526N for you, since it suits your deeper tone now. Want me to add it to your basket?
Got it. Here's a hydrating formula in the same 526N shade, with a more glowy finish. Shall I swap it in?
Thanks for telling me. I'll steer you one step cooler than 516W. 526N is a good match. Want to try it?
No problem. I'll keep 516W from your last order. Would you like me to add it to your basket?
Done. It's in your basket. You're $27 away from your offer. Want a brush that goes with this shade?
No worries. I'll leave your basket as it is. Ask me anything else about this shade.
Do you usually apply foundation with a brush, a sponge or your fingers?
Which undertone suits you now: warm, neutral or cool? If you're not sure, I can help you find out.
What will you mostly wear it for? I'll show you reviews from people who wore it the same way.
Only three results for that. Which matters more to you: a matte finish, all-day wear, or fragrance-free?
Standard shipping is free over $50, and it usually arrives in three to five days.
Hi Linda, welcome back. I can help you pick the right shade.

fallback.say: Sorry, I didn't catch that. You can ask me about shades, delivery, or what changed since your last order.
